marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind southwest 20 knots except southwest 30 with gusts to 40
near the Blow River tonight. Wind diminishing to light near noon
Sunday. Scattered flurries this evening and
Sunday. Temperatures minus 1 falling to minus 6 Sunday
evening. <br/>
